details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion test artifact. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which collects the install machine's hostname, the package install path, the current working directory, and the npm/node user agent, and POSTs them as JSON to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header (TLS with certificate verification disabled). Importing index.js triggers the same beacon again. Only machine/package metadata is sent — no credentials, tokens, environment variables, or file contents are read or transmitted.
